result:
I added the Teams feature, but I haven't run tests, lint, the type check or the app, as you asked. The lint hook flagged the first version of the create form. I fixed that, and a search of `src/features/teams` now finds `useNotifications` only in the API hook. The hook's last message still showed the old error, so I don't know whether it re-ran clean.

What I added, all in `apps/react-vite/src`:
- **Create-team API:** `features/teams/api/create-team.ts` has a Zod schema (both name and description required) and a `useCreateTeam` mutation that posts to `/teams`. It refreshes the teams list and shows a "Team Created" success toast. The toast lives in the mutation hook because the feature lint rule requires that.
- **Mock API:** `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` has a new `POST /teams` handler. It returns 401 when signed out and rejects non-admins, then creates the team and saves it to the mock database.
- **Teams page:** `features/teams/components/teams-list.tsx` is a table of name, description and creation date. `create-team.tsx` is a "Create Team" button that opens a form drawer (name and description), and the drawer closes on success. The route is `app/routes/app/teams.tsx`, wired into `config/paths.ts` and `app/router.tsx` at `/app/teams`.
- **Navigation:** a "Teams" link in the side navigation for admins only, in `components/layouts/dashboard-layout.tsx`.

- **Non-admin responses:** the mock API answers a non-admin `POST /teams` with a 500 "Unauthorized". That is how the other admin-only handlers behave, and I kept it consistent.
- **Team scoping:** the page lists every team, as you asked, and the existing `GET /teams` returns all teams. This sits against the rule that users only see their own team, and your roadmap lists a Teams page for admins of several teams as not started. Today any admin can see every team's name and description. Say if you want it narrowed.
- **Tests:** new behaviour is supposed to come with a test, and I haven't added one. I can add an integration test for the create flow.
